objects.name: access_permissions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "access_permissions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer, "base_album_id" varchar, "is_link_required" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "password" varchar, "grants_full_photo_access" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "grants_download" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "grants_upload" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "grants_edit" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "grants_delete" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "user_group_id" integer, "user_id_unique_key" integer as (COALESCE(user_id, 0)), "user_group_id_unique_key" integer as (COALESCE(user_group_id, 0)), "grants_move" tinyint(1) not null default '0', foreign key("user_id") references users("id") on delete cascade on update cascade, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict on update restrict)

objects.name: album_size_statistics
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "album_size_statistics" ("album_id" varchar not null, "size_thumb" integer not null default '0', "size_thumb2x" integer not null default '0', "size_small" integer not null default '0', "size_small2x" integer not null default '0', "size_medium" integer not null default '0', "size_medium2x" integer not null default '0', "size_original" integer not null default '0', "size_raw" integer not null default '0', foreign key("album_id") references "albums"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("album_id"))

objects.name: album_user_thumbs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "album_user_thumbs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer, "album_id" varchar not null, "photo_id" varchar not null, "user_id_unique_key" integer as (COALESCE(user_id, 0)), foreign key("photo_id") references photos("id") on delete cascade on update cascade, foreign key("user_id") references users("id") on delete restrict on update restrict)

objects.name: albums
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "albums" ("id" varchar not null, "parent_id" varchar, "license" varchar not null default ('none'), "cover_id" varchar, "_lft" integer not null default ('0'), "_rgt" integer not null default ('0'), "album_sorting_col" varchar, "album_sorting_order" varchar, "album_thumb_aspect_ratio" varchar, "header_id" varchar, "album_timeline" varchar, "max_taken_at" datetime, "min_taken_at" datetime, "num_children" integer not null default '0', "num_photos" integer not null default '0', "auto_cover_id_max_privilege" varchar, "auto_cover_id_least_privilege" varchar, "title_color" varchar not null default 'white', "title_position" varchar not null default 'top_left', "header_photo_focus" text, "bucket_key" varchar, foreign key("cover_id") references photos("id") on delete set null on update cascade, foreign key("id") references base_albums("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("parent_id") references albums("id") on delete no action on update no action, foreign key("auto_cover_id_max_privilege") references "photos"("id") on delete set null, foreign key("auto_cover_id_least_privilege") references "photos"("id") on delete set null, primary key ("id"))

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "albums_tags" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "tag_id" integer not null, "album_id" varchar not null, foreign key("tag_id") references "tags"("id") on delete cascade on update cascade, foreign key("album_id") references "albums"("id") on delete cascade on update cascade)

objects.name: base_albums
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "base_albums" ("id" varchar not null, "legacy_id" integer, "created_at" datetime not null, "updated_at" datetime not null, "title" varchar not null, "description" text, "owner_id" integer not null default ('0'), "is_nsfw" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "sorting_col" varchar, "sorting_order" varchar, "copyright" varchar, "photo_layout" varchar, "photo_timeline" varchar, "published_at" datetime, "is_pinned" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "slug" varchar, "title_base" varchar not null default '', "title_index" integer not null default '0', "published_at_orig_tz" varchar, "is_date_scrubber_enabled" tinyint(1), foreign key("owner_id") references users("id") on delete no action on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: cache
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache" ("key" varchar not null, "value" text not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

objects.name: cache_locks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache_locks" ("key" varchar not null, "owner" varchar not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

objects.name: colours
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "colours" ("id" integer not null, "R" integer not null default '0', "G" integer not null default '0', "B" integer not null default '0', primary key ("id"))

objects.name: config_categories
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "config_categories" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "cat" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "description" text not null, "order" integer not null default '255')

objects.name: configs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "configs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "key" varchar not null, "value" varchar, "cat" varchar not null default 'Config', "type_range" varchar not null default '0|1', "description" varchar not null default '', "is_secret" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "level" integer not null default '0', "not_on_docker" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "order" integer not null default '32767', "is_expert" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "details" text, "required_keys" varchar)

objects.name: contact_messages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "contact_messages" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "email" varchar not null, "message" text not null, "is_read" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "ip_address" varchar, "user_agent" varchar, "created_at" datetime not null, "updated_at" datetime not null)

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "faces" ("id" varchar not null, "photo_id" varchar not null, "person_id" varchar, "x" float not null, "y" float not null, "width" float not null, "height" float not null, "confidence" float not null, "laplacian_variance" float not null default '0', "crop_token" varchar, "is_dismissed" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "cluster_label" integer, foreign key("photo_id") references "photos"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("person_id") references "persons"("id") on delete set null, primary key ("id"))

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "failed_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "uuid" varchar not null, "connection" text not null, "queue" text not null, "payload" text not null, "exception" text not null, "failed_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

objects.name: jobs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "attempts" integer not null, "reserved_at" integer, "available_at" integer not null, "created_at" integer not null)

objects.name: jobs_history
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs_history" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "owner_id" integer not null, "job" varchar not null, "status" integer not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("owner_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade)

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "landing_links" ("id" varchar not null, "label" varchar not null, "url" varchar not null, "placement" varchar not null, "open_in_new_tab" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "sort_order" integer not null default '0', "enabled" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "is_built_in" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime not null, "updated_at" datetime not null, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tag_albums_tags
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "tag_albums_tags" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "tag_id" integer not null, "album_id" varchar not null, foreign key("tag_id") references "tags"("id") on delete cascade on update cascade, foreign key("album_id") references "tag_albums"("id") on delete cascade on update cascade)

objects.name: tags
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "description" varchar)

objects.name: tracks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "tracks" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "album_id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "file_name" varchar not null, "disk" varchar not null default 'images', "is_primary" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("album_id") references "albums"("id") on delete cascade)

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "webhooks" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "event" varchar not null, "method" varchar not null, "url" varchar not null, "payload_format" varchar not null default 'json', "secret" text, "secret_header" varchar, "enabled" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "send_photo_id" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "send_album_id" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "send_title" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "send_size_variants" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "size_variant_types" text, "created_at" datetime not null, "updated_at" datetime not null, primary key ("id"))
